description: Checks one collection for schema problems and returns the findings: missing primary key, one-sided or broken relations, a database type that disagrees with its interface, constraints the stored data violates. Read-only, and it reports rather than repairs. Use it after create_collection or apply_schema, or when writes fail for no obvious reason; use diagnose_collection_access when permissions rather than schema are the suspicion. strict: true also reports conventions and warnings instead of errors alone.
name: validate_collection_schema
